comment: Geomagnetic activity is currently at QUIET levels. The anticipated coronal mass ejection (CME) is yet to make an impact and it's either travelling slower than expected which lessens the likelihood of a significant impact or it may have missed. A high-speed stream from a large trans-equatorial coronal hole (CH) is expected to reach the Earth on or around 4-OCT, enhancing geomagnetic activity from the 2nd interval onward. There is a possibility of STORM G1 periods througout the forecast, due to any potential CME glance followed by CH high-speed stream effects.
role: independent advisory; score_effect=0 until prospective validation
